faqs.question: What does 🤎☕ mean?
faqs.answer: 🤎☕ is a relationship-coded combo. The two emojis are picked to mark a moment between two people — partners, family, close friends — more clearly than a single heart emoji could.

faqs.question: Can 🤎☕ befriend-coded?
faqs.answer: 🤎☕ can read friend-coded inside groups where friend-coded and relationship-coded cues blur. Outside that context the read stays relationship-coded.

faqs.question: What is the difference between 🤎☕ and 🤎☕ in a softer register?
faqs.answer: 🤎☕ is the relationship-coded "name" — the cue is shared warmth. 🤎☕ in a softer register is a different register, usually softer or sharper than the relationship-coded default.

faqs.question: Should I use 🤎☕ on an anniversary?
faqs.answer: Yes — 🤎☕ is exactly the register for anniversary-coded moments. The combo lands shared-warmth without forcing additional context.
